image_description: A close-up studio shot of a beaded necklace against a white background. The necklace features alternating large, matte, dark reddish-brown oval beads and smaller, faceted, translucent bright green crystal beads. A single loose brown bead lies detached in the center-left area. The strand curves from the top left, down through the center, and up to the top right.

The internal refraction and facet edges of the green beads appear slightly soft and inconsistent with sharp glass geometry, showing minor 'melting' or smoothing typical of AI generation.
